tasks.short: Supervise and train technical drafting staff

steps.what: Supervise drafters and technicians through work review and feedback
Train technical staff through demonstrations and observed practice

tasks.design: The drafter retains supervision, demonstrations and feedback while using existing drafting software {OTHER}. Training follows observed performance rather than a generated competence score.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical errors and learning needs depend on the work being attempted.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing drafting examples support explanations without replacing supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising misunderstanding before it reaches a released drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor sees how a colleague reasons and adapts coaching.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory responsibility and contact time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate practical training around drawing interpretation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: technical supervision and observed practice remain human; no clerical supervision baseline is specified.

assumptions: Boundary covers supervision and training, not producing the staff member's drawing or recording course attendance.
Staff bring work and questions during s1. The drafter selects examples during s2 and trainees produce practice after each demonstration within that step; no ready-made competence flag is assumed.
OTHER means drafting software. Use existing teaching and viewing functions first; native runtime earns no saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new system or assessment workflow is added.
research_questions: Which supervisory activities require observing drawing creation rather than inspecting the finished result?

already_counted.description: Work feedback, demonstrations and observed practice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+45=100. Gross and net 0%; all supervision and live training remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Produce mechanical illustrations for technical publications

steps.what: Lay out illustrations and choose views that explain operation and maintenance
Draw and annotate mechanical illustrations for reference manuals
Reproduce illustrations and verify the publication output before release

tasks.design: Configure saved publication presets in drafting software {OTHER} to reproduce the drafter's completed illustrations. The drafter still chooses views, draws explanatory details and checks the final set in {DOCS} before release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated output settings can require manual re-entry for each illustration.
tasks.enabler_now: Saved native publication settings can repeat a known export without generating mechanical content.
tasks.still_hard: Showing a safe and comprehensible maintenance sequence in a limited drawing.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter chooses what a technician needs to see and checks mechanical meaning.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of repetitive publication setup is removed; illustration design responsibility stays unchanged.

reach.task: Agree illustration callouts and page references

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: saved native export presets can reduce repeated publication setup. The digest has no measured mechanical-illustration drafting result; the small saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers illustrating existing mechanical designs and reproducing the finished files, not engineering design or writing the full manual.

In s1 the drafter captures view IDs, illustration IDs, units, scale, page size, output format, line-weight profile and destination in the native publication preset; the full 35% remains. In s2 the drafter produces the exact source file versions. Missing or changed settings require manual reproduction and checking in s3.

OTHER means drafting and illustration software. Test existing saved export configuration first. No saving is credited where batch export is already used, and physical printing or handling remains unchanged.

The retained 9 hours in s3 cover final visual inspection, callout checks, correction and release. Three additional focal hours cover preset changes and unusual publication exceptions; no work is transferred to the technical author.
unknowns: Existing publication presets and actual repeated setup time
Required paper copies and external publication approvals
research_questions: Does saved output configuration reduce hands-on time after including setup and visual checking?

incremental.description: Publication preset maintenance and extra exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact output file versions, source illustration versions, callouts, publication preset and recipient checked in s3; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+50+15*0.60=94. Gross 6%, minus 3 focal upkeep gives net 3%. Range covers an already configured publication process with zero additional gain through repeated exports with 5 points removed and 3 upkeep. Drawing and physical handling retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Shade and colour drawings to clarify technical details

steps.what: Shade or color drawings to clarify details and dimensions

tasks.design: The drafter applies and checks physical shading and colour on the drawing. A scanned copy in {DOCS} can preserve the result without removing the stated manual illustration work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Choosing emphasis and applying it to a physical drawing requires visual judgement and hand work.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital illustration tools exist, but switching the required medium has not been established here.
tasks.still_hard: Emphasising useful detail without obscuring dimensions or misleading the reader.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter judges technical readability in context.
tasks.altitude: The physical illustration task remains unchanged.

reach.task: Review whether illustration emphasis supports the explanation
reach.learn: Reader needs and accessible visual conventions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: the stated ink, crayon, airbrush and overlay work includes physical application and visual judgement; no labour reduction is demonstrated.

assumptions: Boundary is the stated shading and colouring of a drawing, excluding drawing design and later publication.
The drafter selects emphasis from the drawing and requirements during s1; there is no structured detail mask supplied free.
Check native digital drawing options only if the required deliverable permits them. Existing software runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no process or tooling change is introduced.
unknowns: Whether physical drawing media remain required
research_questions: Can the recipient accept a digital drawing with equivalent readability?

already_counted.description: Selection, physical application and visual checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100; net 0%. Scenario retains physical shading and checking because a change of medium is unconfirmed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sketch, trace and reproduce working drawings

steps.what: Draw freehand sketches of mechanical designs
Trace finished drawings onto designated reproduction paper
Reproduce working drawings on copy machines and check the copies

tasks.design: The drafter retains freehand design work, physical tracing and copy handling. Existing records in {DOCS} can identify the source revision without replacing the specified paper deliverable.
tasks.previous_blocker: The stated task includes physical tracing and reproduction requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital source management can prevent revision confusion, but a digital-only delivery contract is not established.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining accurate dimensions and legibility through physical reproduction.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter checks that a workshop reader can safely interpret the drawing.
tasks.altitude: Sketching and paper reproduction remain unchanged in this scenario.

reach.task: Agree the working copy and revision used in the workshop
reach.learn: Drawing control and workshop delivery requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: automated copier runtime is already machine work; loading, tracing and checking cannot be counted as removed without changing the physical task.

assumptions: Boundary covers sketching, tracing and copying, not engineering approval or full drawing production.

The drafter produces sketches in s1. The responsible design owner supplies the finished source drawing under the existing drawing process before s2; it need not be the unfinished sketch. The drafter produces the reproduction master in s2 before copying in s3.
Copy requirements are agreed with the workshop under the existing process and checked by the drafter in s3; no free structured reproduction contract is introduced.
Check existing native drawing exports if delivery requirements change. Existing copy-machine runtime earns no human saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because the physical process is unchanged. These copies are distinct from the technical-publication illustration release in task 1459.
unknowns: Frequency of physical tracing and paper-copy requirements
research_questions: Which physical copies can the workshop replace with controlled digital access?

already_counted.description: Sketching, tracing and physical copy handling

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+40+20=100. Net 0%; no saving from existing copier runtime or an unagreed change to paper requirements.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Mechanical judgement, illustration choices and supervision stay with the drafter; publication presets offer a small conditional gain.
reach: Coordinate technical illustrations and controlled working copies with authors and workshop technicians.
role.ambitious_version: Clearer technical illustrations and better practical coaching with measured, modest publication savings.
